title: PDF Sheets
description: The World of Darkness 20th anniversary character sheets, drawn from their PDFs with the PDFs' own art, and filled in like the fillable PDFs. One sheet has a tab for every game (Vampire, Werewolf, Mage, Changeling, Hunter, Demon, Wraith, Mummy, Kindred of the East); pin one as the character's game. Stays linked to the system's own data, so rolls, health and token bars keep working.
